summary: The parent's two sliding cells were never timed because of a real ordering bug in its [op] timing data. The fix is small and the question was never answered: does the one-pass ticket merge pay at PSEUDO verify B=1 and at sd decode B=32? The in-prepare interleaved A/B is enough; no companion. Judge on the PATH CHOSEN ratios and the verify_1 splitkv_attn_sk_kernel row, not the headline.
justification: Root cause (parent patch, _op_cell_ps and _op_cell_sd): both build data = _ps_synthetic(...) then ref = _ps_reference(data, ...) BEFORE any _ps_prepare_q(data); _ps_reference attends over the cache as the pre-attention kernel left it, so it sees random pre-generated K/V at the new-token rows instead of the RMS-normed, RoPE'd rows. The error tracks the number of new rows (verify L=8 9.64e-02, decode L=1 3.65e-02), identical for incumbent and twin and at the step-up grid: a harness mismatch. The real per-case runner calls prepare first and passes at 1.7e-03. Fix: _ps_prepare_q(data) once (sync) before _ps_reference in both cells (pre-attention writes are idempotent). Mechanism: verify_1 sliding 13.50 us (sk kernel 9.8 + pre-attn 1.8), floor 0.12 us, latency-bound; at p8 (~8 slots) the winner's merge is on the tail: ~4 dependent round trips -> ~1, saving ~0.4-0.75 us; the 1.01x gate needs ~0.12 us. Headline +0.3..0.5%. sd decode_32 at p4 saves ~0.2 us, likely at or under the bar. Weakest link: full decode measured the merge's price as tiny (x1.002-1.005); twins 9/11 carry 127/117 regs vs 121 (no spill).
confounders: restack-sk-pseudo-cluster-plus-v3-fused-preattn: installed PSEUDO verify B=1 at p8 under the two-pass merge; read the print-only step-up (sm) readout.
restack-sliding-decode-sk-window-on-cluster-master: sd route variant 6 at p4; a flat result there does not refute the mechanism; read the p8 step-up readout.
full-decode1-streamk-s3-two-level-ticket: the host kernel; twin differs only in the merge template flag (canary exact).
sk-full-line-gather: check that the gather PATH CHOSEN line reads full-line.
sliding-verify-s2b-b17-32-bar103: the sw gate takes the import clock to ~295 s; [op] must stay inside its 430/460/480 s guards.
interference: No companion: in-prepare interleaved A/B (variant 4 vs 9, 6 vs 10), same module, cold-L2, empty graph subtracted, 2 x 21 reps, 1.01x both rounds + IQR guard; the MB-4 twin 11 readout separates pass fusion from batch depth. Read the PATH CHOSEN ratios, the incumbent's newly printed timing-data rel L2 (should be ~1.7e-03) and the scored verify_1 sk kernel row (9.8 us in ba8c8a61).
rules_flags: None: the fix moves a prepare-time _ps_prepare_q call ahead of the reference on synthetic gate data; keep it inside _op_* and behind the import-clock guard.
